llm_response.reason: The domain fb-business.com mimics Facebook/Meta business support but is not an official Meta property, as confirmed by external sources warning of phishing attacks leveraging similar domains. The site is referenced in scams that use urgency, impersonation, and psychological pressure on Facebook business account owners (characteristics 3, 13, 16). These tactics align closely with common technical support and account verification scam strategies. The site is inaccessible (403 error), which also frequently occurs with scam sites under investigation or takedown.
